description: This file defines a custom presenter class `OceanRowHeaderPresenter` for use with Android's Leanback library, specifically for customizing row headers in an Android TV app. It creates and binds views that display uppercase header titles with styling and an underline indicator that responds to focus.

classes.name: OceanRowHeaderPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter for row headers in Leanback, with styling modifications like uppercase text and an underline indicator.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view holder containing header views: title and underline.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to views, setting the header text in uppercase.

methods.name: onSelectLevelChanged
methods.description: Adjusts the underline's visibility based on focus level.
